company.shortDescription: Dream3D is a generative AI platform that allows creators to produce studio-quality 3D scenes through plain-text prompts.
company.description: Dream3D is a generative AI platform that allows creators to produce studio-quality 3D scenes through plain-text prompts. The platform supports command-based editing—once a placeholder (like a white cube) is generated in your scene, you can ask the AI to replace it with your described object in under 30 seconds.

aiResearchSummary.text: Graphic rendering using diffusion models discloses a system or method for generating computer graphics where three dimensional scenes are rasterized into two dimensional images, features are extracted, and text prompts are generated. This aligns with Dream3D’s generative AI platform that lets creators produce studio quality three dimensional scenes from plain text prompts. Overall, Dream3D is researching and developing text driven three dimensional scene generation and graphics rendering using diffusion based methods.
